themes.readme:
# AEW

Gold and black arena theme. Import it from Settings → Theme. It becomes your Custom theme.

Five wallpapers are stored in the file.

databases.title: Real World 2026
databases.author: Dark Magic Studios
databases.readme:
# Real World 2026

A 2026 roster: promotions and wrestlers. Import the `.bbdb` in DataStudio.

Portraits and logos are not inside the file. Each `picture` and `logo` is a filename, such as `Damien Sandow.jpg`. This pack does not bundle those images and does not name an image host.
